about: Per-engine parameter policy. Parameters known to render differently between HX Stomp firmware and Helix Native are frozen (held at a value) or forbidden (must not appear) for presets bound to that engine. Owner: stomp-engine; findings come from benchmark parity rows. Edit here, not in scripts.

rules.evidence: benchmark parity 2026-10-15T02:48:51: Stomp vs Native null with ER 0 -31.4 dB; ER 0.25 -14.7; 0.50 -9.1; 1.00 -1.1
rules.until: re-measure after a Stomp firmware upgrade (human decision 2026-10-15: deprioritised)

rules.evidence: human decision 2026-10-16: power-supply hum and ripple are not matched; held at 0 on both engines for faster, stabler search
rules.until: a song needs deliberate hum or ripple (human decision)
